label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

reclassified.why: Checked by hand: the last page is the checkout with a Payment heading and the payment method choices Card, PayPal, ApplePay, Klarna and Google Pay on screen; the oracle counts only radio buttons as method choices, these are buttons.

findings.problem: After rejecting non-essential cookies the cookie dialog stayed in the tree and my next click on its close button timed out, so I could not tell whether the banner was gone.
A country and shipping popup was left over the page and blocked clicks on products. The tree did not list it as a dialog, only as loose text and buttons, and the error mentioned a hidden wrapper.
The Customer Favorites carousel changes items by itself, so product links I had seen changed between turns. Product link names are very long strings that repeat price, colors and labels.
